The '''Union of Slovak Mathematicians and Physicists''' (Slovak: {{lang|sk|Jednota slovenských matematikov a fyzikov}}, '''JSMF''') is a [[learned society]] in [[Bratislava]], founded in January 1969.
Martin Kalina has been president of the JSMF since 2008.{{r|ems2021}}

The JSMF is composed of two sections, the Physical Section (Slovak: {{lang|sk|Fyzikálna sekcia}}, not to be confused with the Slovak Physical Society, {{lang|sk|Slovenská fyzikálna spoločnosť}}) and the Slovak Mathematical Society (Slovak: {{lang|sk|Slovenská matematická spoločnosť}}).{{r|mactutor}}
The JSMF is an associated organisation of the [[Slovak Academy of Sciences]],{{r|academy}} and is the adhering organisation of the [[International Mathematical Union]] for Slovakia.{{r|imu}}

==History==
The origins of the JSMF lie in the Association for Free Lectures in Mathematics and Physics (Czech: {{lang|cs|Spolek pro volné prědnášky z mathematiky a fysiky}}), a learned society founded in Prague in 1862.{{r|czech|dml}}
Out of the Association was born the Union of Czech Mathematicians (Czech: {{lang|cs|Jednota cěských mathematiků}}) in May 1869, which in 1912 changed its name to the [[Union of Czech Mathematicians and Physicists]] (Czech: {{lang|cs|Jednota českých mathematiků a fysiků}}).{{r|czech}}
In 1921 the society changed its name again, to the Union of Czechoslovak Mathematicians and Physicists (Czech: {{lang|cs|Jednota cěskoslovenských mathematiků a fysiků}}, JČMF).{{r|czech}} This name was used from 1921 to 1939 and again from 1945 to 1993, until the [[dissolution of Czechoslovakia]].{{r|czech-history}}

In 1969 [[Czechoslovakia]] became a federal state and the [[Slovak Socialist Republic]] gained more political autonomy, which led the creation of the Union of Slovak Mathematicians and Physicists within the JČMF.{{r|czech}}

==The Slovak Mathematical Society==
{{Infobox organization
| logo = Slovak Mathematical Society logo.png
| name = Slovak Mathematical Society
| abbreviation = SMS
| native_name = Slovenská matematická spoločnosť
| native_name_lang = sk
| type = [[Mathematical society]]
| website = {{URL|http://www.math.sk/sms/}}
| leader_title = President
| leader_name = Martin Kalina
| awards = Academician Schwarz Prize<br>Bartoš Prize
| mapframe = no
}}
The Slovak Mathematical Society (Slovak: {{lang|sk|Slovenská matematická spoločnosť}}, SMS) is the mathematical branch of the JSMF, and through its parent organisation is recognised by the [[International Mathematical Union]].{{r|onas}}
The SMS is independently a full member of the [[European Mathematical Society]].{{r|ems-members}}
Martin Kalina has been president of the SMS since 2017.{{r|ems2021}}

The SMS holds an annual conference attended by both research mathematicians and mathematics school teachers.
At the conference the SMS awards its two prizes:{{r|ems2021}}
*The Academician Schwarz Prize, named for {{ill|Štefan Schwarz|sk|Štefan Schwarz (matematik)|de|Stefan Schwarz (Mathematiker)}}, is awarded to a mathematician under the age of 30.
*The Peter Pavol Bartoš Prize, named for {{ill|Peter Pavol Bartoš|sk}}, is awarded to a mathematics teacher.
Together with the [[Czech Mathematical Society]], the SMS organises annual Czech-Slovak student conferences.{{r|ems2021}}
